clues: It is the capital and largest city of a province in China. It is the heart of trade, learning, and trips for that province.
Its nickname means it feels like spring all year long. The weather stays mild through every season, not hot or cold for long.
In 1910, the French built a train line to Vietnam. The new line made this city grow rich and strong.
In World War Two, a team of pilots made its home here. Folks called that team the Flying Tigers.
Its Golden Temple is the largest bronze temple in all of China. It dates back to the time of the Ming dynasty.
